Server middleware is only recovery/CORS (`server/server.go:50-53`); API stacks add auth, logging, recovery, and a 256 MiB body-size cap—not rate limiting (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:95-98,126-144`; `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:20`).
